title: Gate decision
description: One line of _data/gate-decisions.jsonl -- the decision inbox, the idea log's discipline scaled down to one gate resumption (PLAN-039.01 section 7). Append-only, one sanctioned writer (tools/append_decision.py), dedup key (run_id, gate, decision_seq): a second decision for an already-resumed gate is refused by the writer before it is appended, so this file cannot itself record a conflict. The repository artifact a decision produces is the durable truth; this file only requests that a gate's thread be resumed.

run_id.description: The run whose interrupted gate this decision resumes. Matches a `started` event's `run_id` in _data/runs.jsonl.

gate.description: The gate's name, matching the `gate` field of the `gate_reached` ledger event it resumes.

decision.description: approve=resume the interrupted branch forward | reject=resume down its failure edge | amend=re-key: apply the owner's amendments to the repository artifact, abandon this thread, and let reconcile open a new one at the amended position (PLAN-039.01 section 7).

decision_seq.description: One-based count of decisions recorded for this (run_id, gate) pair. Part of the dedup key: a run whose gate is reached a second time (for example after an amend re-keys and the amended thread reaches the same gate name again) gets decision_seq 2, and so on. The writer computes this automatically; a caller-supplied value that does not match the next expected sequence is refused.

at.description: When the decision was recorded, RFC 3339 with a mandatory offset. Generated by the writer; there is no flag to supply one.

decided_by.description: Who decided -- `repository-owner` for every gate this phase's scope covers (attended-only operation); carried as a field rather than assumed so a later phase that widens who may decide does not need a schema change.

notes.description: Free text the owner attaches to the decision, for example the amendment itself. Optional.
